semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiji Semiconductor is a state-holding OSAT specializing in back-end services, including assembly and testing, which are critical in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Taiji Semiconductor (Suzhou) Co., Ltd is a state-holding OSAT company in China that provides comprehensive back-end semiconductor services. The company offers turn-key solutions that include research and development, assembly, testing, and surface mount technology (SMT) with a wide range of packaging capabilities.
capabilities: Advanced packaging types including wBGA, FBGA, FlipChip, MCP, UDP, LGA, SOP, QFP, QFN, MEMS
Customized product packaging and testing services

regional_presence.China: Taiji Semiconductor is a state-holding company with a significant presence in China, focusing on semiconductor back-end services.
